deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to Settings > Checkout.
In the checkout settings, click on 'Additional content' under the 'Order information' section.
Click on the '+ Add block' button and select 'HTML' from the dropdown menu.

Paste the following code into the HTML block: <form id='returns-reason-form'>
  <label for='reason'>Reason for return:</label>
  <select id='reason' name='reason'>
    <option value='defective'>Defective</option>
    <option value='not-as-described'>Not as described</option>
    <option value='changed-my-mind'>Changed my mind</option>
    <option value='other'>Other (please specify)</option>
  </select>
  <input type='text' id='reason-other' name='reason-other' placeholder='Please specify reason for return' style='display:none;'>
  <button type='submit'>Submit</button>
</form>
Click on the 'Save' button to save the changes.
In your Shopify theme's liquid files, navigate to templates/returns.liquid and add the following code: {{ form['returns-reason-form'] | raw }}
Save the changes to the returns.liquid file.

To capture the selected reason for return in your Shopify returns flow, you'll need to create an API webhook that listens for 'order.update' events. Navigate to Settings > Apps and then click on 'Manage webhooks'. Click on the '+ Add webhook' button and select 'Order updated' as the event type. In the 'Webhook URL' field, enter a URL that points to your server-side endpoint where you'll handle the webhook request.
Save the changes to create the webhook.
